Plays this book after the one you are listening to ends.
Reads the whole book into audio files, one per chapter, in Audiobooks on your phone, to play in any app or offline. Runs in the background; a long book takes hours.
Records the book\'s voice ahead of time while your phone charges, about 6 hours at a time, so listening starts at once and uses less battery.
The book\'s clean text as an EPUB and a text file in Documents/ListenLock, for screen readers, braille displays and other reading apps.
An EPUB 3 in Documents/ListenLock with the voice in sync with the text, for e-book apps that read along. Takes about as long as reading the book aloud.
Your highlights, bookmarks and voice notes for this book as a Markdown and a text file in Documents/ListenLock.
Who is who in this story, only up to where you are, so nothing is spoiled.
Takes the book out of ListenLock. The PDF stays on your phone.
Take a photo of a printed page; ListenLock reads it aloud as a one-page book.
Pick folders; new PDFs in them join your library each time you open ListenLock.
Saves your library, places, notes and settings to one file you keep, or restores one on a new phone.
Fill-in-the-blank questions from your highlights in every book, read aloud.
